descriptions.value: The CrewAI CodeInterpreter tool falls back to SandboxPython when it cannot reach Docker, which can enable RCE through arbitrary C function calling.
La herramienta CodeInterpreter de CrewAI recurre a SandboxPython cuando no puede acceder a Docker, lo que puede habilitar RCE mediante la llamada arbitraria a funciones C.
CrewAI contains a arbitrary local file read vulnerability in the JSON loader tool that reads files without path validation, enabling access to files on the server.
CrewAI contiene una vulnerabilidad de lectura arbitraria de archivos locales en la herramienta de carga JSON que lee archivos sin validación de ruta, permitiendo el acceso a archivos en el servidor.

CrewAI contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that enables content acquisition from internal and cloud services, facilitated by the RAG search tools not properly validating URLs provided at runtime.

CrewAI contiene una vulnerabilidad de falsificación de petición del lado del servidor que permite la adquisición de contenido de servicios internos y en la nube, facilitada por las herramientas de búsqueda RAG que no validan correctamente las URL proporcionadas en tiempo de ejecución.
CrewAI does not properly check that Docker is still running during runtime, and will fall back to a sandbox setting that allows for RCE exploitation.
CrewAI no verifica correctamente que Docker sigue ejecutándose durante el tiempo de ejecución, y recurrirá a una configuración de sandbox que permite la explotación de RCE.

CrewAI before 1.15.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the validate_url function that performs one-shot DNS resolution and blocklist checks before returning the original URL unchanged. Attackers can bypass the security filter by supplying URLs that redirect to internal addresses or use DNS rebinding techniques to access internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

CrewAI anterior a 1.15.1 contiene una vulnerabilidad de falsificación de petición del lado del servidor en la función validate_url que realiza una resolución DNS única y comprobaciones de lista de bloqueo antes de devolver la URL original sin cambios. Los atacantes pueden eludir el filtro de seguridad al proporcionar URLs que redirigen a direcciones internas o utilizar técnicas de reenlace DNS para acceder a servicios internos y puntos finales de metadatos en la nube.
A vulnerability in FileWriterTool in crewai-tools <= 1.10.2rc1 allows a remote attacker to achieve code execution via malicious path traversal sequences in the filename argument.
A SQL injection vulnerability in NL2SQLTool in crewai-tools v1.10.2rc1 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands via an unsanitized sql_query argument.

CrewAI before fb2323b offers a Python blocklist approach that operates at the wrong level of abstraction, a different vulnerability than CVE-2026-2275. Import-time blocking of module names does not address the availability of Python's complete object graph. For example, calling ctypes.CDLL(None) loads the C library without relying in any import statements. In other words, a within-process sandbox cannot merely account for the import system and instead must account for the complete runtime of the Python interpreter.

crewai-tools through 1.15.28 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in SeleniumScrapingTool that allows attackers to fetch internal resources because it never applies the validate_url private-address check. Attackers influencing agent tool input through prompt injection can direct headless Chrome to loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata addresses to disclose internal data and cloud credentials.

CrewAI crewAI Framework Agent Loading Unsafe Reflection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of CrewAI crewAI. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must load a malicious agent configuration from the repository.

The specific flaw exists within the load_agent_from_repository function. The process does not properly restrict a user-supplied argument before using it to import a module. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-28387.

MLflow is an open source AI engineering platform for agents, large language models, and machine learning models. From 2.19.0 until 3.17.0, mlflow.crewai.autolog() records CrewAI Agent objects without consistently sanitizing nested credential-bearing values. mlflow/crewai/autolog.py::_get_agent_attributes() converts the Agent llm field to a string that includes the provider API key, while mlflow/crewai/autolog.py::_construct_full_inputs() expands the Agent object into mlflow.spanInputs. Applications can therefore send plaintext provider credentials to the MLflow trace backend or a configured OTLP destination, where trace readers can obtain them. This issue is fixed in version 3.17.0.

CrewAI contains an SSRF vulnerability caused by its SSRF guard and HTTP client, which both miss malicious content in URLs by checking opposite content passed to it, enabling any request that injects a malicious URL to perform SSRF, such as with the ScrapWebsiteTool.
